correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the finite coding problem to exact set packing over all 24 received permutations. The least-available-output recurrence is exhaustive and nonoverlapping: each packing either omits that output or contains exactly one selected descendant mask covering it. The embedded standard-library verifier reconstructs all objects from definitions, evaluates all 525,881 reachable states, and reproduces maximum 12, 67,163,560 labeled maxima, the complete footprint histogram, 14,024,815 perfect maxima, and the explicit perfect witness. No impossibility conclusion relies on timeout or partial enumeration.

value.rationale: The parameter \((n,s)=(6,2)\) is a natural first finite benchmark for the foundational two-way interleaving construction: the 2015 paper’s two-burst theorem takes \(n=2m\) with \(m\ge3\), so its first length is \(6\). Determining the exact optimum and complete maximizer/footprint census sharpens the smallest instance of that published infinite construction family, and the large perfect-code subpopulation records additional packing structure rather than a routine table recomputation.
